status: posthoc development diagnostic; not preregistered or held-out
input_policy: Use all four saved A/B draft/final states; never edit or replace them.
task_source: Frozen input_A.json/input_B.json: work footprint 0.80 x 0.50 m and dining footprint 0.60 x 0.40 m.
purpose_A: Separate-in-time surface use is allowed; storage and transition are not certified by this diagnostic.
purpose_B: Work footprint remains at exactly the same location during dining; the two footprints cannot overlap.
declared_scope: Geometric footprint witnesses on declared desk/dining-table top surfaces. Not ergonomic use, whole-task success, human preference, or rigid-body simulation.
surface_extraction: Union of upward horizontal triangles at the mesh maximum z; z tolerance 1e-5 m, normal tolerance 1e-7, numerical inward boundary margin 1e-6 m.
obstruction_check: Closed mesh cross-section rings of every other exported object at surface_z + 1e-4 m. Unclosed intersecting sections make free-space certification unknown. This is a planar obstruction check, not a volume sweep.
search: Ordinary deterministic enumeration at 0.01 m center spacing, orientations 0 and 90 degrees, plus the surface bounding-box center. A returned polygon is checked against the actual triangle union. No witness means not-found, never global infeasibility.
controls: object AABB capacity (necessary relaxation, not proof)
ordinary joint footprint enumeration with persistent work location
cost: CPU only; no model inference, paid API, training, additional scene generation or GPU.
interpretation: Existing collisions and unknown original requirements remain visible. Never turn a planar witness into a complete-scene positive or preference label. Counts are correlated states of one development room.
